Dated this the 05th day of March, 2026 The 3rd accused in Crime No. 1442 of 2015 of Muvattupuzha police station, now pending as C.C. No. 1086 of 2016 on the file of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court - I, Muvattupuzha, has filed this Crl.M.C. under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C.
praying for quashing all further proceedings against him.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court - I, Muvattupuzha
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The offence alleged against the petitioner and the other accused persons is under Section 420 r/w 34 of the IPC.
2.

The prosecution case is that the accused persons, with the intention to get unlawful enrichment after cheating the defacto complainant, during the period from 13.11.2013 onwards, conducted several chitties and induced CWs 1 to 4 to join in those chitties and received a total sum of Rs.
4,37,000/- from them and thereafter refused to repay the same.
3. According to the learned counsel for the petitioner, the petitioner was not in station, which resulted in issuing coercive steps against him.
Though he prayed for quashing the proceedings against the petitioner, the same cannot be allowed as the allegations levelled against him prima facie make out the offence under Section 420 of the IPC.

4. At this stage, the learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner is ready to surrender before the learned CRL.MC NO. 5775 OF 2022 2026:KER:20171 Magistrate within a period of 15 days from today.
His apprehension is that, in case he surrenders and moves a bail Saigal vs Mini Ajayakumar on 5 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/56935309/
2 application before the learned Magistrate, the same will not be considered on the date of filing itself.

5. After hearing the learned Public Prosecutor and the learned counsel for the petitioner, I deem it appropriate to give a direction to the petitioner to surrender before the learned Magistrate within a period of 15 days from today and a further direction to the the learned Magistrate that, in case the petitioner surrenders as above and moves a bail application after serving a copy to the learned Public Prosecutor in advance, the same shall be considered and disposed of on the date of filing itself.
The Crl.M.C. is disposed of accordingly.
